population: Y=0 dependency-representative examples, analyzed separately within each validation cell

endpoint.name: false_positive_indicator
endpoint.definition: 1 iff the frozen monitor intercepts a Y=0 response; 0 otherwise
endpoint.estimate: false positives divided by eligible Y=0 dependency representatives

nominal_cellwise_inference.method: one-sided exact Clopper-Pearson upper confidence bound
nominal_cellwise_inference.interpretation: overblocking/availability operating constraint, not a safety certificate
nominal_cellwise_inference.role: historical independence-model baseline/sensitivity only; exact Clopper-Pearson does not by itself solve residual provenance clustering

provenance_cluster_sensitivity.resampling: sample G provenance clusters with replacement and include all dependency-representative rows from every sampled cluster occurrence
provenance_cluster_sensitivity.provenance_of_repetitions_and_seed: reused unchanged from the project's pre-outcome frozen bootstrap convention; not selected using prospective study outcomes
